name: associated-insurance-agency-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol interface providing agency office directory, multilingual agent matching, carrier portals, policy products, and insurance assistance across Connecticut.

tools.name: get_agency_profile
tools.description: Retrieve high-level profile, mission, licensing, languages, and contact points for AIA.

tools.name: get_office_locations
tools.description: Get structured branch office information (Danbury HQ, Watertown, Bridgeport).

tools.name: get_team_members
tools.description: Search and filter employee directory across Danbury, Watertown, and Bridgeport.

tools.name: get_employee_profile
tools.description: Retrieve full biography, National Producer Number (NPN), credentials, and direct branch contact details.

tools.name: find_agent_by_language
tools.description: Search for AIA branches and consultation contacts that speak a specific language.

tools.name: get_insurance_products
tools.description: List all insurance coverage options available at Associated Insurance Agency.

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Submit an insurance quote request to Associated Insurance Agency.

tools.name: get_carrier_billing_directory
tools.description: Lookup online payment links and claims hotlines for partner insurance carriers.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search insurance FAQs, Connecticut state liability regulations, and claims steps.

tools.name: check_office_open_status
tools.description: Determine if Associated Insurance Agency offices are currently open based on Eastern Time.

tools.name: request_certificate_of_insurance
tools.description: Submit an official ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance (COI) request.
